title: Robotics Engineer
description: A roadmap for robotics software: mechanics intuition, sensors, ROS 2, simulation, perception, control, and autonomous robot projects.

tree.name: Robotics Foundations
tree.description: Build the math, programming, electronics, and mechanical intuition needed to reason about robots.

children.name: Python/C++ for Robotics
children.description: Use Python for scripting and C++ for performance-sensitive nodes, drivers, and control loops.

children.name: Kinematics and Control Basics
children.description: Learn coordinate frames, transforms, velocity, feedback control, PID, and robot motion constraints.

tree.name: ROS 2 and Simulation
tree.description: Use ROS 2 nodes, topics, services, actions, launch files, parameters, bags, and simulation tools.

resources.title: Learn ROS 2: Beginner to Advanced (Kevin Wood)

children.name: ROS 2 Nodes and Communication
children.description: Build publisher/subscriber nodes, services, actions, parameters, transforms, and launch systems.

children.name: Simulation with Gazebo
children.description: Create simulated worlds, sensors, robot models, plugins, and test scenarios before using hardware.

children.name: Practice: Navigation Failure Replay
children.description: Record a failed robot run, inspect sensor data, adjust parameters, and explain the navigation failure.

tree.name: Perception, Navigation, and Portfolio
tree.description: Combine sensors, mapping, localization, planning, and control into autonomous robot behavior.

resources.title: OpenCV Course - Full Tutorial with Python (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: Navigation and SLAM
children.description: Use maps, odometry, localization, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and navigation stacks.

children.name: Project: Simulated Autonomous Robot
children.description: Build a ROS 2 robot in simulation that senses, localizes, navigates, avoids obstacles, and logs runs.

tree.name: Hardware Integration and Testing
tree.description: Bridge simulation and real robots with sensor calibration, safety checks, hardware drivers, and repeatable experiments.

children.name: Sensors and Calibration
children.description: Integrate cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, encoders, depth sensors, calibration targets, and synchronized timestamps.

children.name: Experiment Logs and Safety
children.description: Plan tests, record bags, analyze failures, set safety limits, and write reproducible experiment reports.
